answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a stake locked for a long vesting period and slashed on proven misbehavior. One honest agent climbs to the summit of trust slowly, through repeated useful work, while a sybil farm must pay the same lockup for each copy, so its cost scales linearly with the number of fakes. A coordinated attack falls to its nadir once one copy is caught, because the shared funding trail links the clones and burns all their stakes at once. Reputation is a mesa: flat, hard to climb, and expensive to fake at scale.
